div.div:
Standard Tier: Use default runtimes (runC) for internal, trusted apps.
Premium Tier: Use gVisor for multi-tenant SaaS apps to prevent cross-tenant breaches.
Ultra-Secure/Regulated Tier: Use Kata Containers for customers with strict compliance
needs (PCI-DSS/HIPAA) who require the hardware-level isolation of a VM.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 418px; height: 1px; padding-top: 627px; margin-left: 437px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#000000, #ededed); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
apiVersion: node.k8s.io/v1
kind: RuntimeClass
metadata:
name: gvisor # This is the name you will use later
handler: runsc # This tells the underlying container engine to use gVisor

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 318px; height: 1px; padding-top: 737px; margin-left: 437px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: 'Comic Sans MS'; color: light-dark(#000000, #ededed); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
name: premium-tenant-app
namespace: tenant-a-premium
spec:
replicas: 2
selector:
matchLabels:
app: my-app
template:
metadata:
labels:
app: my-app
spec:
# HERE IS THE MAGIC LINE
# This forces Kubernetes to find a node with gVisor
# and use it to run these containers.
runtimeClassName: gvisor
containers:
- name: my-container
# This image was built with a standard Dockerfile
image: my-company/standard-image:v1
ports:
- containerPort: 80
